answers.core: When it comes to implementation of things that involve scopes, that needs to be a language level detail.
answers.workaround: For the case of the `class` keyword, yes. You can create a new file and use the new `class_name` keyword to have a global reference to the class. For `enum`, the best you can do is copy and paste the definition every time you want to reference it.

title: Allow enums and local classes to be used outside of the file they are defined
